mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 6.5% triggers a labor market tightening, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in months with UNRATE >6.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) or the increase in UNRATE does not precede the return decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) above their 12-month averages signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) despite both proxies exceeding their 12-month averages, or the correlation between proxies and returns is weak (IC <0.15).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% signals anticipated monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls >1% from previous month in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day returns in late-cycle periods with CPIAUCSL declines are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) or the decline in CPIAUCSL does not precede the return increase.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS above 130,000 persons signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) despite PAYEMS exceeding the threshold, or the increase in employment does not precede the return surge.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a decline in UNRATE indicates tightening labor market conditions and aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5pp and UNRATE falls >0.3pp from previous month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) despite the combined movement of proxies, or the correlation between the proxy pair and returns is weak (IC <0.15).

mechanism_narrative: During an expansionary phase, a sustained monthly rise in GDPC1 above 5% from the prior month signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% from previous month in expansionary phase
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding the threshold, or the rise in demand does not precede the return increase.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO below 93.5 (its 2023 average) signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) despite INDPRO falling below the threshold, or the drop in supply does not precede the return decline.
